# Draft:Edward Smith

Edward Smith (born 26 November 1992) is a English football manager and former player. Dubbed "Mini André Villas-Boas" by his peers, he became the youngest manager in women's football in 2012 when he took over Bury FC Women aged 19.
Association Football
Early life
Edward Smith was born on 26 November 1992 in Bury, Greater Manchester. He attended his local primary school St Marie's RC Primary before continuing his education at St Gabriel's RC secondary school.
